main.description: A statement by the repository's owner about a bundle — that they vouch for it, or that it is bad — identified by its whole-file hash — the hash a bundle signature covers. The record key is that hash in lowercase hex, so there is at most one attestation per account per bundle, and a verifier knows which record to ask for.

hash.description: The whole-file hash as '<algorithm>:<lowercase hex>', e.g. 'sha256:3f1a…'. Must equal the algorithm the bundle's manifest declares and the record key.

kind.description: What is being vouched for. A policy can require a particular kind from a particular attester.

verdict.description: Whether the attester vouches for the bundle or warns against it. Absent means good. Only good verdicts count towards a requirement; a bad verdict is shown to anyone installing the bundle, and refuses it under a policy that blocks on this attester.

note.description: A short free-text note; informational only.

createdAt.description: When the attester made the attestation, by their own clock.
